Title: Azure Site Recovery available for Azure Government

Body.Content:
U.S. public sector customers can now use Azure Site Recovery (ASR) to protect their critical applications running on physical and virtual infrastructures, including Hyper-V and VMware. Some of the top capabilities that come with ASR in the Azure Government cloud are:
  • Data security and secure transmission Data is encrypted in transit and at rest in Azure.
  • Screened personnel Azure Site Recovery operations and support as part of Azure Government are performed by background-screened, U.S. citizen personnel.
  • Business continuity Azure Site Recovery is a highly reliable service and guarantees 99.9% availability as set forth in the ASR SLA.
  • Attractive pricing Customers can use Azure Site Recovery for protecting their workloads at no charge for 31 days.
To get started, request an Azure Government trial subscription. If you already have an Azure Government subscription, simply try out Azure Site Recovery.
